summary: RREEF Property Trust filed an 8-K disclosing that its board unanimously approved a Plan of Complete Liquidation and Dissolution on September 15, 2026, pursuant to Sections 331, 336 and 346(a) of the Code and Maryland law. Effectiveness requires majority stockholder approval, expected at a special meeting in early 2027. The plan authorizes asset sales and wind-down without further stockholder approval, payment of claims, and potential transfer of residual assets to a liquidating trust with in-kind distributions. No price, premium, advisor or close date was disclosed. Watch for the special meeting timing and estimated distributions to stockholders.
